assumptions: Pinned Solidity0.8.30, Cancun optimizer200 compilation and EVM runtime semantics
Fresh actual canonical contract with empty immutable token allowlist; no ERC20 generalization
SMT single-transaction checks with fresh native trade, uint128-positive principal and explicit distinct actor classes
SMT trusted known-contract calls; compiler abstractions/unsupported features are retained and block unqualified proof
No claim of fiat receipt, transaction inclusion, seller cooperation, wallet/browser security or external audit

properties.plainStatement: Native zero-address asset is not an allowlisted ERC20 in the fresh empty-allowlist deployment.
A distinct non-seller caller cannot release the fresh native trade or mutate its participants/principal/state.
properties.formalStatement: caller != seller implies release reverts and state'=Funded and seller'=seller and buyer'=buyer and amount'=principal
properties.assertion:
assert(!released && observed.state == BasicEscrow.State.Funded && observed.seller == address(this)
            && observed.buyer == buyer && observed.amount == msg.value);

properties.plainStatement: Refund before the funded deadline refuses and preserves the native trade.
properties.formalStatement: chainTime < deadline implies refund reverts and state'=Funded and buyer'=buyer and amount'=principal
properties.assertion:
assert(!refunded && observed.state == BasicEscrow.State.Funded && observed.buyer == buyer
            && observed.amount == msg.value && observed.deadline > block.timestamp);

nativeRefinement.plainStatement: Native principal is active while Funded, then paid or owed to the fixed recipient; donation surplus is never principal.
nativeRefinement.formalStatement: depositedPrincipal = activePrincipal + pendingPrincipal + paidPrincipal; custody = activePrincipal + pendingPrincipal + surplus; paidPrincipal <= depositedPrincipal
assumptions: One native trade, rejecting then accepting buyer, fixed known principal, forced surplus injected with vm.deal
Caller gas fees are outside custody-principal accounting
Receiver and native gas/runtime behavior remain assumptions beyond this replay

strictModelCounterexample.plainStatement: The strict terminal-already-paid model does not refine intended push-to-credit behavior.
strictModelCounterexample.qualification: Intended deferred credit, not a theft defect. Formal-properties baseline must explicitly account for pending liabilities; no silent model weakening or production approval.

guardLogic.scope: Exact compiler AST pre-payout side-effect-free revert predicates only; no modifier/storage/payout/bytecode theorem
guardLogic.domains: state 0..3, address uint160, timestamp uint256, deadline uint64; actual Funded enum value1

partitionInvestigation.scope: At most one attempt per unchanged original property under one finite shared budget; does not replace original UNKNOWNs, guard-only proofs or native credit counterexample.
